### Day 99: Matthew 4:23
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-99-matthew-4-23.html
Passage: Matthew 4:23
Points:
- Jesus prioritized proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom despite relentless demands from the crowds.
- Physical healing addresses temporal earthly bodies, whereas the kingdom message addresses eternity.
- Christ performed miracles out of sovereign authority, deep compassion, and to validate His divine identity.
- Believers must be careful not to allow urgent situational needs to distract them from their ultimate mission.

### Great Crowds Follow Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/great-crowds-follow-jesus
Passage: Matthew 4:23-25
Points:
- Jesus traveled extensively across Galilee to proclaim the arrival of God's saving kingdom.
- Crowds gathered from both Jewish and Gentile regions, anticipating the global reach of the gospel.
- Christ's healings and exorcisms served to authenticate His divine authority and defeat Satan's rule.
- Christians are called to follow Jesus' example by actively sharing the gospel in their everyday spheres.
